[考古学家莱芬]
我现在好多了！走吧！

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Even if we can't talk, I can still figure something out by looking at people's lifestyle.
Okay, let's go! Please show me the way! To the nearest place!
scripts.translation:
[考古学家莱芬]
就算不能和他们交谈，观察他们的生活方式也能让我推断出些事情。
好了，走吧！请带我去最近的地方！

scripts.text:
- ^424242I didn't mean that about the talking part, but let's go anyway.
To the nearest place... ^FF0000Let's go to the hungry ^424242woman.^000000 -
scripts.translation: - ^424242我不是那个意思......不过还是走吧。去最近的地方......^FF0000那个饥饿的女子^424242那里。^000000 -

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
You are here again today.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家莱芬]
你今天又来了。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
As I told you, I'm not going to leave until I found the secret of this place.
Are you here to go to Narin?
scripts.translation:
[考古学家莱芬]
我说过，不查明这里的秘密我就不走。你是要去找娜琳吗？

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Uh, I didn't tell you. I'm taking a sabbatical year.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家莱芬]
啊，忘了告诉你，我请了一年长假。

scripts.text:
[Archeologist Leiphen]
Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[考古学家莱芬]
走吧！

scripts.text: - ^424242I think I saw something.^000000 -
- ^424242It seems to be getting a little cold.^000000 -
- ^424242I feel weird, but nothing is here...^000000 -
- ^424242I heard something.^000000 -
This is a totem that glows softly in blue.
scripts.translation: 这是一个泛着幽幽蓝光的图腾。

scripts.text: Touch it
scripts.translation: 触碰

scripts.text: Leave it
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: - You cannot enter the area because your level is too low.
scripts.translation: - 你的等级不足，无法进入该区域。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品栏物品过多，无法继续。 -

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ah! Ah! Ah!
I've heard that they hire adventurers because they don't have enough hands to defend the village. I guess that's you?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
啊！啊！啊！
我听说村里人手不够守卫村庄，所以雇了冒险者。你就是他们雇来的人吧？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
By the way, haven't I seen you somewhere? Your face looks strangely familiar.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
对了，我是不是在哪儿见过你？你的脸看起来很眼熟。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Oops, I'm not in a position to compare similar faces... We're twins. Ha ha ha
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
哎呀，我可不该拿相似的脸来比较......我们是双胞胎。哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Should I say hello? Nice to meet you. I'm Luanda, the defense manager of this cave.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
先打个招呼吧。很高兴认识你，我叫卢安达，负责管理洞窟防卫。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
For simple quests, we have prepared a request board, so you can find them and report them to me.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
简单的委托都贴在公告栏上，你可以接取任务，再向我报告。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The quest itself doesn't have to be difficult, as you just have to go around the cave and deal with the monsters or bring the byproducts of the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
任务不会太难，你只要在洞窟周边巡查、处理魔物，或收集它们掉落的材料就行。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Since you've been hired by the village, I'd like you to work hard and lighten the burden a bit. It's really hard these days. Please.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
既然村里雇了你，就拜托你多出点力，帮忙减轻我们的负担。最近实在太忙了，拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Then have a good time. Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
那祝你玩得开心，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the strange shimmering you had witnessed.
scripts.translation: 我把看到的奇怪闪光告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
A strange shimmer? As you said, it's a really strange phenomenon.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
奇怪的闪光？听你这么一说，确实挺反常的。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I've lived in the village for a long time, but it seems like a phenomenon I've never heard of. I'm guessing, but I think it's just started happening recently.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我在村里住了很久，却从没听说过这种现象。猜测一下，应该是最近才出现的。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I don't live alone in the village, and if someone had seen it, it would have been rumored, but hearing it for the first time would make my guess clear.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我不是独自住在村里。要是有人见过，早该传开了。既然从没听说过，那就说明我的猜测没错。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It could be dangerous, so if you find it, why don't you avoid it? There's no need to take a risk.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
这可能很危险。要是再遇到，就避开吧，没必要冒险。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about three young men you met and talked to.
scripts.translation: 我把遇到并交谈过的三个年轻男子告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Uh.. huh?! You saw me and young men who look like like my brothers.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
呃......什么？！你见到我和几个长得像我兄弟的年轻人了？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It seems like it happened a long time ago. Unlike Mao, I don't have a very good memory.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
那应该是很久以前的事了。我记性可不像毛那么好。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I vaguely remember it. I did warn a stranger I met before I went hunting with my brothers.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我隐约记得。以前我和兄弟们去打猎前，确实警告过一个陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's not uncommon to see strangers in town, so my memory is hazy, but I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
镇上偶尔会有陌生人来，所以记忆有点模糊，不过我记得这件事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's interesting. If what you're saying is true, doesn't that mean you've been talking to me in the past?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
真有意思。如果你说的是真的，那你以前就和我交谈过了？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ah! Come to think of it, do you remember the first time we met? Didn't I say I was used to being an adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
啊！这么说来，你还记得我们初次见面时，我说自己习惯了和冒险者打交道吗？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
As expected, I don't think it was a bad feeling. I really can't believe it. An adventurer who met me in the past...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
果然，这种感觉不坏。我真不敢相信......你竟然是过去就见过我的冒险者......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
That sounds like something similar could happen in the future, right?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
听起来未来也可能发生类似的事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I apologize. Deep down, I felt that it was annoying for adventurers to talk to me. Now, I'll ask you first.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
抱歉，其实以前我觉得冒险者来找我说话挺烦的。以后我会主动问你。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
If you ever go through something similar, please let me know. I'm begging you.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
下次要是再遇到类似的事，记得告诉我。拜托了。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told him about Karoo and Asudem.
scripts.translation: 我把卡鲁和阿苏德姆的事告诉了他。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Puhahaha I think you came to see the place where Hyung-nim and sister-in-law are dating.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
噗哈哈，你是去看哥哥和嫂子约会的地方吧？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Oh my gosh.. that place is where my brother and sister-in-law often went on dates.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
天哪......那地方确实是哥哥和嫂子常去约会的地方。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
My brother might think it's a secret place only he knows, but it's a place everyone in the village knows.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
哥哥可能以为那是只有他知道的秘密地点，其实村里人人都知道。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's quite a popular spot among village lovers. It's quiet and a good place for a date.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
那地方在村里的情侣之间很受欢迎，既安静又适合约会。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Recently, I haven't had much to laugh about because of various things, but thanks to you, I laughed out loud. I look forward to the next story.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
最近各种烦心事让我都笑不出来了，多亏你让我开怀大笑。期待下次听到你的故事。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about who was painting murals in the cave.
scripts.translation: 我把在洞穴里画壁画的人告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Have you ever met me when I was painting the mural? I don't remember, but...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你见过我画壁画吗？我不记得了，不过......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I think I can tell you why I painted the mural.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我想我可以告诉你自己为什么要画那幅壁画。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's not much of a secret, but each of my brothers has a mysterious ability.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
这不是什么秘密，我的每个兄弟都有一种不可思议的能力。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
In the case of Karoo-hyung, he has the ability to see accurately even from a distance..
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
比如卡鲁哥哥，他能从很远的地方看清事物......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Maknae Maru has an excellent memory that never forgets what she has seen and the ability to read her opponent's mind..
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
最小的玛鲁记忆力惊人，见过的东西都不会忘，还能读懂对手的心思......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I'm not always correct, but I can see into the future. Ah! I have more abilities than that.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我虽然不能总是预测准确，却能预见未来。啊，我还有别的能力呢。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I can see people's good and evil energy. In the case of adventurers...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我能看见人身上的善恶气息。至于冒险者嘛......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I can feel the good energy that can't be touched. That's why I feel more bitter.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我能感受到那种看不见、摸不着的善意。所以才觉得格外苦涩。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Coming back to the original story, the reason I'm painting the mural is because one day I dreamed of a village burning down.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
说回壁画吧，我会画它，是因为有一天梦见村庄被大火吞噬。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Many monsters have come to town and people are crying out in pain because of it...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
许多魔物涌进村子，村民们痛苦地哀嚎......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
After the hellish dream, I saw myself recording the day's events on a mural in a cave.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
那场地狱般的梦之后，我又看见自己在洞穴壁画上记录那天发生的事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Haha, don't worry too much. The dream hasn't happened yet.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
哈哈，别太担心，梦里的事还没发生呢。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Do you know? If I paint the mural in advance, will the future I saw in my dream change?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你说，要是我提前画好壁画，梦里看到的未来会不会改变？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
An adventurer I haven't seen in my dreams is helping us, so I'm sure we can change it.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
有位我从没在梦里见过的冒险者正在帮助我们，所以我相信未来能改变。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about Mao, who was training alone.
scripts.translation: 我把毛独自训练的事告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Mao guy... you've been thinking about a lot of things.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
毛那家伙......你倒是想了不少事啊。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Brother Karu lives separately from his sister-in-law, and we still live together, but I don't think he cared too much about his sister.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
卡鲁哥哥和嫂子分开住，我们还住在一起。不过我觉得他不怎么关心妹妹。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's said that I lost my mind after having a painful dream, but somehow my anxiety...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
听说我做了个痛苦的梦后就失去了理智，可不知为何，我还是觉得不安......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Looks like he's been infested with Mao. Maybe because of his abilities, he's often swayed by other people's emotions...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
他似乎被毛的情绪影响了。也许是因为有那种能力，他总会受到别人的情绪左右......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
He... training to become stronger... even if he doesn't become stronger... he's still enough...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
他......为了变强而训练......可就算没变得更强......他也已经足够好了......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Thank you. Thanks to you, I found out about Mao's troubles.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
谢谢你，多亏了你，我知道了毛在烦恼什么。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about someone who was taking something from the cave.
scripts.translation: 我把有人从洞穴里拿走东西的事告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You saw that too. I think we've talked about it before. In my dream, I saw monsters coming into town.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你也看见了啊。我们之前好像聊过这件事。我在梦里见到魔物涌进了村庄。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
And in preparation for that time, the village warriors evacuated the elderly and weak to this place, and they stored supplies here and there in the cave.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
为了应对那一天，村里的战士把老人和体弱者疏散到这里，还在洞穴各处藏了物资。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
These are literally emergency items. It would be perfect if they were not used, but...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
那些确实是应急物资。最好永远都用不上，可是......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You don't know how the world works. If you find something, just ignore it.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你还不懂世事。看到什么就当没看见吧。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of meeting the villagers and the village chief.
scripts.translation: 我把遇见村民和村长的经过告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You really came to see what happened a while ago. It wasn't as much damage as you saw in your dream, but it was a lot of damage.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你真的去看了那时发生的事。虽然没你梦里看到的那么严重，损失还是很惨重。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
When I think of that day, my heart hurts. All of a sudden, when my brothers were away...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
一想到那天，我就心痛。兄弟们突然都不在身边......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Still, the village chief, the best elder in the village, seems to have suffered less damage because he was calm. Thanks for the story.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
不过村长是村里最年长、最德高望重的人，幸好他当时保持冷静，损失似乎小些。谢谢你告诉我这些。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of meeting the brothers who ran somewhere in a hurry.
scripts.translation: 我把遇到匆忙离开的兄弟们的事告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You must have seen the day my brothers and I came back from hunting. There was a big disaster in the village and it was the next day.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你看到的应该是我和兄弟们打猎回来那天。那场灾难是在隔天发生的。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Kuh.. If me and my brothers hadn't emptied the village... the people wouldn't have been taken by the monsters...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
咳......要是我和兄弟们没把村民疏散出去，他们就会被魔物抓走......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
If so... my sister-in-law also...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
那样的话......我嫂子也会......

scripts.text: It's not your fault.
scripts.translation: 这不是你的错。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I know. It's not because of me and my brothers.. but.. that day.. we.. .. .. it's just a pity
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我知道。那不是我和兄弟们的错......可是......那天我们......唉......真让人难过。

scripts.text: You'd better calm down first.
scripts.translation: 你先冷静下来。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
You've shown me, adventurer, something I wouldn't have seen. I'm just here to tell you what I remember...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
冒险者，你让我看到了本来不可能看到的事。我只是在这里告诉你我记得的事情......

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about the story of seeing Karu and Asudem.
scripts.translation: 我把看到卡鲁和阿苏德姆的事告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ka.. Karu hyungnim.. hyungnim
That's the reason why you shut yourself up in the west cave.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
卡......卡鲁哥哥......
所以你才把自己关在西边的洞穴里。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I feel resentful of myself for not being able to help with the village defense.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我怨恨自己没能帮忙守护村庄。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Your heart... I can't even imagine your sister-in-law's... whoo... your sorrow...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你的心情......我甚至不敢想象嫂子有多难受......唉......你一定很悲痛......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
When the situation here is sorted out, I will look for my older brother. He must be alone in pain and sorrow.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
这里的事情解决后，我要去找哥哥。他一定独自承受着痛苦和悲伤。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
My heart hurts like this too, but if you know the youngest who struggles because of his abilities... I'll have to prepare. Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我自己也很难受，可还有个弟弟正因自己的能力而苦恼......我得振作起来。谢谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Told Luanda about stories of unknown people.
scripts.translation: 我把遇到一些陌生人的经历告诉了卢安达。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It sounds like a conversation between a Wootan or Megalith monster targeting the village.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
听起来像是乌坦族或邪恶摩艾正打算袭击村庄。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Follow a strong leader? Recently, I felt that the movements of these guys are disturbingly orderly...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
要追随强大的首领吗？最近这些家伙的行动确实整齐得反常......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It seems that a monster has appeared to lead them.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
看来有个魔物出现，统领了它们。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's embarrassing. Even now, all we can do is block it.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
真惭愧。即使到了现在，我们也只能勉强挡住它们。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
This is not the time to be sad. We need to build more defenses and take other measures.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
现在不是难过的时候。我们得加强防御，再想想别的办法。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
A strong leader is also a problem... but a power that has been handed down as a legend? This is a story I've never heard of before.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
强大的首领已经够棘手了......传说中流传下来的力量？我从没听过这种事。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I'm guessing this is the reason why the monsters are attacking the village, but I'll have to tell the chief and investigate.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
这大概就是魔物袭击村庄的原因。我得告诉村长，再调查清楚。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The story you just told me was really helpful. Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
你刚才告诉我的事很有帮助。谢谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text: Reported to Luanda and gained experience.
scripts.translation: 向卢安达报告，获得了经验值。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's a situation where even one request is regrettable, but {0}... really.
You worked hard.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
哪怕少接一份委托都让人遗憾，不过{0}......真的辛苦你了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Each and every request is precious. Thank you again and again.
You worked hard.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
每一份委托都很重要。再次感谢你，辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
What's up, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
怎么了，冒险者？

scripts.text: Is there no request here?
scripts.translation: 这里没有委托吗？

scripts.text: What is this cave?
scripts.translation: 这座洞穴是什么地方？

scripts.text: Why are monsters invading?
scripts.translation: 魔物为什么会入侵？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
For quests that are recruiting in town, there is a separate request board.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
城镇里的招募委托另有一块公告板。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ah! Watch your mind. The location is in the middle of the battlefield, so I installed it in the corner for safety reasons.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
啊，注意安全！公告板原本在战场中央，为了安全起见，我把它移到了角落。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
There are cases where you cannot complete a request on the bulletin board right away, but there is no specific time limit, so don't be in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
公告板上的委托有时没法马上完成，不过没有时限，不用着急。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Adventurer, you are really curious about everything.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
冒险者，你对什么都很好奇啊。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The Luanda Caves are strategically the only way out north of town.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
卢安达洞窟是城镇北面的唯一通道，战略位置很重要。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
That's why we're defending against monster attacks here.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
所以我们才在这里抵御魔物的袭击。

scripts.text: Luanda Cave? Luanda?
scripts.translation: 卢安达洞窟？卢安达？

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
Ah! Did you notice? Yes, my name is Luanda too. The village elders say...
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
啊，被你发现了？没错，我也叫卢安达。村里的长老说......

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
The triplets are said to have been named Karu, Luanda, and Mao after the village caves.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
据说三胞胎卡鲁、卢安达和毛，是以村里的洞窟命名的。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
My neighborhood friends teased me a bit when I was young, but I don't have any complaints about the name.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
小时候，附近的朋友偶尔会拿这个名字开玩笑，不过我并不介意。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
I heard they were named after the guardians of the village. I'm rather proud of them.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
听说这些洞窟是村庄的守护者，我还挺为名字感到自豪的。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
It's very puzzling to us too. If we knew why, we'd have put everything away.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
我们也不清楚原因，实在令人费解。要是知道怎么回事，早就想办法解决了。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
This isn't a town with plenty of food, and I don't think there's any particular reason for monsters to target it.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
这里食物并不充裕，我不觉得魔物是为了什么特别的理由盯上村庄。

scripts.text:
[Luanda]
But what can we do? We're just living here, and the monsters keep coming, so we have to live while blocking them.
scripts.translation:
[卢安达]
可我们又能怎么办？我们住在这里，魔物却不断来袭，只能一边抵挡一边过日子。

scripts.text: It's a bizarre shimmer that you're likely to be sucked into.
scripts.translation: 这是一道奇异的闪光，似乎会把人吸进去。

scripts.text: It seems like a phenomenon that can't be ignored. I'll have to talk to Luanda, the head of defense.
scripts.translation: 这种现象不能置之不理。我得去找防卫负责人卢安达谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Um... Uhm...

[Jerrymon]
Oh, what a surprise!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
哎呀，真让人惊喜！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
What's up? I'm busy right now, so I'll talk to you later.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
怎么了？我现在有点忙，晚些再聊。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Um... Uhm...

[Jerrymon]
Oh, what a surprise!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
哎呀，真让人惊喜！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
What's up? I'm a bit busy right now...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
怎么了？我现在有点忙......

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ah, you're the one introduced by Raket. I've been waiting for you.
Can you show me your fishing rod?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
啊，你就是拉凯特介绍来的那位吧。我等你好久了。
能让我看看你的鱼竿吗？

scripts.text: - Jerrymon began to examine the rod closely. -
scripts.translation: - 杰里蒙开始仔细检查鱼竿。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes, that's right... this substance is just that... to discover it again like this...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
没错......就是这种物质......竟然又发现了......

scripts.text: What material are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你说的是什么材料？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Adventurer, do you know where the deepest part of the sea is?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
冒险者，你知道海洋最深处在哪里吗？

scripts.text: Well...??

[Jerrymon]
It is a place called the ^4d4dffTrench^000000. To put it simply, you can think of it as a deep cliff in the sea.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那个地方叫^4d4dff海沟^000000。简单来说，就像海底的一道深渊。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It is known that there are hundreds of different types of trenches in the world's oceans.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
据说世界上的海洋里有数百条不同的海沟。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The widest and deepest known trench is the ^4d4dffBahia Trench^000000 near Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
目前已知最宽、最深的海沟，是依斯鲁得附近的^4d4dff巴伊亚海沟^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
There are rare life forms at the bottom of the trench, and marine scientists like myself have shown great interest and have been exploring them.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
海沟底部栖息着稀有生物。我和其他海洋学家对此很感兴趣，一直在研究它们。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Though shallow trenches can be explored to some extent.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
浅海沟多少还能探索一番。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
But in the case of the Bahia Trench, scientists have calculated that scientifically, no life can exist because it is so incredibly deep.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
但巴伊亚海沟深不可测，科学家认为那里不可能存在生命。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I recently found out that there is life in the Bahia Trench.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
最近我却发现，巴伊亚海沟里真的有生命。

scripts.text: How do you know that??
scripts.translation: 你怎么知道的？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
You can tell by the stone that contains my magic.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
从这块蕴含我魔力的石头就能看出来。

scripts.text: A stone with magical power?
scripts.translation: 蕴含魔力的石头？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes, I'm a mage-turned-oceanographer. I learned magic for oceanography.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
没错，我原本是魔法师，后来转行研究海洋。学习魔法就是为了做海洋研究。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Enchant a large boulder and make it fall to the floor where the trench exists.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我在巨石上施加魔法，再让它沉到海沟底部。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The magic on the dropped stone is connected to me, so by measuring the distance, I can get a little idea of how deep it is and what's going on near the stone.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
沉下去的石头上的魔法会与我相连。通过测量距离，我就能大致判断海沟有多深，以及石头附近的状况。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
To tell you what I found out...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我来告诉你发现了什么......

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The composition of normal sea water and deep sea water is almost the same. But the only difference is the deep sea of Bahia Trench.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
一般海水和深海海水的成分几乎相同，但巴伊亚海沟深处的海水却不一样。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Should I say it's like water and oil? There's a section where they never mix.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
该怎么形容呢？就像水和油一样，有一层界面让两者永远无法混合。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
A strong boundary was formed where they meet each other, and it felt as if the deep seawater in that section was desperately blocking the seawater coming down from above.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
两种海水交界处形成了强力屏障，仿佛那里的深海水在拼命抵挡上方的海水。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The water pressure is also much lower than that of normal seawater, so it is assumed that it has a favorable environment for life.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那里的水压也低得多，所以我推测环境适合生命生存。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
We call it ^4d4dffdeep seawater^000000
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我们称它为^4d4dff深渊海水^000000。

scripts.text: Is this gloss related to what you said?
scripts.translation: 这种光泽和你刚才说的发现有关吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes! That's right!!
We only identified the existence of Abyssal Seawater deep in the Bahia Trench, and it was very difficult to obtain samples. This fishing rod has a lot of Abyssal Seawater on it...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
没错！就是这样！
我们只在巴伊亚海沟深处确认过深渊海水的存在，而且很难采集样本。这根鱼竿上却沾了不少......

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Could you leave this fishing rod with me? I think I can figure something out if I extract this sea water and turn it into essence.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
能把这根鱼竿留给我吗？我想提取海水并制成精华，说不定能查出些什么。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Oh, and I heard that the fishing rod was found today. Can I ask you to check if there is another floating substance in the nearby sea?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
对了，听说这根鱼竿是今天才发现的。能帮我检查一下附近海域，看看有没有其他漂浮物吗？

scripts.text: Okay, I'll be back.
scripts.translation: 好，我马上回来。

scripts.text: I'm a bit busy right now...
scripts.translation: 我现在有点忙......

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please come back to me when you're done!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
忙完后请回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes, thanks! I'll be waiting for you!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
好，谢谢！我等你回来！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
抱歉打扰你，不过拜托了。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
抱歉打扰你，不过拜托了。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ah, welcome, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
啊，欢迎回来，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The investigation is going smoothly~
Hey, could you take a look at this?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
调查进展顺利～
嘿，能帮我看看这个吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
See those two little water bottles here?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
看到这两小瓶海水了吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
One side is normal seawater, and the other side is seawater mixed with seawater from the abyss buried in fishing rods. I'll try mixing these two.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
一瓶是普通海水，另一瓶混有从鱼竿上提取的深渊海水。我来试着把它们混在一起。

scripts.text: - Jerrymon poured both waters into one bottle and began to shake them together. -
scripts.translation: - 杰里蒙把两种海水倒进同一瓶里，开始摇晃。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Now, look. As I said before, they don't mix at all, do they?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
看到了吗？正如我刚才说的，两种水完全混不到一起。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
This... this!!

[Jerrymon]
If you shake it like crazy!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
要是使劲摇晃的话！！

scripts.text: [Jerrymon] Wow!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [杰里蒙] 哇！！！！！！

scripts.text: [Jerrymon] Uwachachaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [杰里蒙] 呜哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

scripts.text: [Jerrymon] Ahhhhhhh!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [杰里蒙] 啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊......

scripts.text: Oh, I'm going to catch someone, is it okay?
scripts.translation: 等等，我要去抓个人，可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Keep... Whoa... Whoa... OK now.
- Looking into the bottle Jerrymon is holding, I can clearly see the shape of the vortex. -
scripts.translation: - 仔细看着杰里蒙手里的瓶子，我清楚地看见了漩涡的形状。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Now, do you see this whirlpool!! This is the passage that connects to the bottom of the Bahia Trench!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
看见这个漩涡了吗？！这就是通往巴伊亚海沟底部的通道！

scripts.text: ??? Isn't that just a whirlpool created by shaking it?
scripts.translation: ？？那不就是摇出来的漩涡吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
No. This is the stone that contains my magical power. Let's look at it.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
不是。这块石头蕴含着我的魔力，你看。

scripts.text: - Jerrymon put a glowing stone into the bottle. The glowing stone was sucked into the whirlpool inside the bottle and disappeared without a trace! -
scripts.translation: - 杰里蒙把发光的石头放进瓶里。石头被瓶中的漩涡吸了进去，转眼消失得无影无踪！ -

scripts.text: No, how could it be?
scripts.translation: 不可能吧？怎么会这样？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Did I ever tell you that the stone that contains my magic can measure the distance to me?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我有告诉过你吗？蕴含我魔力的石头可以测量它与我之间的距离。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It feels the same as the last time I threw a pebble into the Bahia Trench..
If you follow this whirlpool, you may be able to find the owner of the fishing rod.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
感觉和上次我把石子扔进巴伊亚海沟时一样......
顺着这个漩涡走，或许能找到鱼竿的主人。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The problem is... the amount of essence on a fishing rod can't make a whirlpool large enough for a person to fit in.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
问题是......鱼竿上的精华不够多，无法形成足以让人通过的漩涡。

scripts.text: Is this amount okay?
scripts.translation: 这些够了吗？

scripts.text: - Showed the ^4d4dff{0}^000000 received from Gein to Jerrymon. -
scripts.translation: - 把从盖因那里拿到的^4d4dff{0}^000000展示给杰里蒙。 -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Oh, just in case, I actually found it!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
哦，幸好我真的找到了！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
With this amount, I think I can create a vortex of fissures that normal people can enter. You can pass it to me.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
有了这些，我应该能制造出普通人也能进入的裂隙漩涡。把它交给我吧。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The place is too small to do this much here, so let's do it in Izlude. In order to get help from your friends.
Then see you in Izlude!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
这里空间太小，施展不开。我们去依斯鲁得岛吧，也好找你的朋友们帮忙。
依斯鲁得岛见！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then let's meet in Izlude!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那我们依斯鲁得岛见！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'm sorry to bother you, but please. I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
抱歉打扰你了，不过拜托了。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Sirood]
Thank you very much, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[西鲁德]
非常感谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Sirood]
I thought I'd never come back...
scripts.translation:
[西鲁德]
我还以为自己再也回不来了......

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Hello, my name is Soup, a friend of Sirood who is missing.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
你好，我叫汤，是失踪者西鲁德的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
The four of us, Sirood, Raket, Gein, and I often enjoyed fishing.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
我们四个人——西鲁德、拉凯特、盖因和我——经常一起钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
That windy day... I had been feeling very guilty for not stopping Sirood from going fishing.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
那天风雨交加......我一直很自责，没能拦住西鲁德去钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
When I heard that Sirood's fishing pole was found, I jumped out.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
听说找到了西鲁德的鱼竿，我立刻赶了过来。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
You must have a clue about something?
scripts.translation:
[汤]
你一定找到什么线索了吧？

scripts.text:
[Soup]
I did my best.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
我已经尽力了。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Should Sirood come back safely?
scripts.translation:
[汤]
希望西鲁德能平安回来。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Sirood is back with us.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
西鲁德已经回到我们身边了。

scripts.text:
[Soup]
Thanks to you, adventurer. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[汤]
多亏了你，冒险者。真的太感谢了。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
It's been exactly 3 months since Sirood went missing.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
西鲁德失踪到现在，正好三个月了。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Sirood's fishing rod was found.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
找到西鲁德的鱼竿了。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I felt that way.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
我也有这种感觉。

scripts.text: What do you think?
scripts.translation: 你怎么看？

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Why is this only discovered now, isn't this a message from someone?
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
为什么偏偏现在才发现？会不会是有人留下了什么讯息？

scripts.text: Looking at it, it doesn't make sense.
scripts.translation: 看起来完全说不通。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Ha... It's just my delusion. I especially miss that child today.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
唉......大概只是我想多了。尤其是今天，我特别想念那孩子。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Heh heh... It's so hard to use all your strength...
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
呵呵......要使出全力还真不容易......

scripts.text:
[Raket]
But for Sirood's sake...
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
不过，为了西鲁德......

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Thank you so much!!
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
真的太感谢你了！！

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Now you can fish with Sirood again.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
现在你又能和西鲁德一起钓鱼了。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I'm so glad...
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
太好了......

scripts.text:
You have too many items.
Please clean up your items and try again.
scripts.translation:
你的物品栏已满。
整理好物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Haha... why did this only get discovered now??
It's impossible, this is...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
哈哈......为什么偏偏现在才找到？！
不可能，这一定是......

scripts.text: - I feel serious anguish from this person. Let's come back after I've become level 140. -
scripts.translation: - 我感受到他心中强烈的痛苦。等达到140级后再回来吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Haha...why did this only get discovered now??
It's impossible, this is...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
哈哈......为什么偏偏现在才找到？！
不可能，这一定是......

scripts.text: Do you have any concerns?
scripts.translation: 你有什么烦心事吗？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Oh, hello...
- He is very fidgety with a fishing pole in his hand. It doesn't look like he's out fishing. -
scripts.translation: - 他手里握着鱼竿，显得坐立不安。看起来不像是来钓鱼的。 -

scripts.text: [Gein] This fishing rod belongs to my friend Sirood who went missing three months ago. I found something!!!
scripts.translation: [盖因] 这根鱼竿属于我那位失踪三个月的朋友西鲁德。我找到线索了！！！

scripts.text: Disappeared?
scripts.translation: 失踪了？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Yes... Sirood is a fishing fanatic and came here to fish whenever he had a chance.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
是啊......西鲁德是个钓鱼迷，一有空就会来这里钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Influenced by Sirood, we also fell in love with fishing, and the four of us often had a good time.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
受他的影响，我们也爱上了钓鱼。我们四个人常常一起玩得很开心。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Sirood's passion for fishing was to the point that he invited us to go fishing even in the rain and wind.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
西鲁德痴迷钓鱼，就算刮风下雨也会约我们出来。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
The day Sirood went missing was exactly the same rainy and windy day. I put on my raincoat and went to go fishing.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
西鲁德失踪那天，正好也是个风雨交加的日子。我穿上雨衣，准备去钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
We were invited to go out together, but they all declined.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
他约我们一起出门，可大家都拒绝了。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Sirood went fishing alone and we haven't seen him since...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
西鲁德只好独自去钓鱼，从那以后我们就再也没见过他......

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I should have stopped you from leaving...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
我真该拦住你，不让你出门......

scripts.text: - Gein started talking again after wiping away tears for a moment. -
scripts.translation: 盖因擦了擦眼泪，稍稍平复后又继续说。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
The news of Sirood's disappearance immediately spread throughout Izlude and a large-scale search was conducted with a lot of time and manpower invested, but the search ended without finding any clues.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
西鲁德失踪的消息很快传遍依斯鲁得岛。大家投入大量人力物力展开搜寻，可最后还是一无所获。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
After that, we got together and ran everywhere to find Sirood, but there was no result, and we were about to give up.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
后来我们几个又到处寻找西鲁德，仍然毫无结果，眼看就要放弃了。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
But just now!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
可就在刚才！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
After 3 months!!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
失踪整整三个月后！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Sirood's fishing pole has risen above sea level. His item was nowhere to be found during the search!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
西鲁德的鱼竿浮出了海面。之前搜寻时，根本没找到他的任何物品！

scripts.text: Now, calm down... Are you sure it's Sirood's fishing rod?
scripts.translation: 先冷静......你确定那是西鲁德的鱼竿吗？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Yes, I'm sure! It's the fishing rod I've always seen.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
当然确定！我一直都认得那根鱼竿。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
This fishing rod was made by Sirood himself, so it is the only one. You can see the initials on the handle here, S.R.D!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
这是西鲁德亲手做的，独一无二。看，握柄上刻着他的名字缩写：S.R.D！！

scripts.text: Oh, then why now...
scripts.translation: 咦，那为什么偏偏是现在......

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I'm so surprised and shocked right now that I don't know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
我现在又惊又慌，完全不知道该怎么办。

scripts.text: - But looking closely at the fishing rod, I feel something different. This wooden fishing rod has been submerged in water for 3 months, but it still looks the same, and I can see a bit of shiny gloss... -
scripts.translation: - 仔细观察鱼竿，我觉得有些异样。这根木制鱼竿在水里泡了三个月，外表却和原来一样，还泛着些微光泽...... -

scripts.text: Isn't this fishing rod a bit strange over there?
scripts.translation: 这根鱼竿是不是有点奇怪？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Strange, what is it?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
奇怪？哪里不对？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Uh...

[Gein]
Uh.....??

[Gein]
It's been submerged in water for 3 months... but it hasn't corroded at all. It's completely fine??
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
在水里泡了三个月......竟一点也没腐坏，完好无损？！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Hmm... And it seems to have a subtle glow... It seems like the fishing rod is coated?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
嗯......而且还泛着微光，像是鱼竿表面覆了什么东西。

scripts.text: -The person who seemed to be Gein's friend who was listening to the story opened his mouth. -
scripts.translation: 一直听着盖因讲述、看起来像他朋友的人开口了。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Where is it, I want to see it!! What's wrong??
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
在哪儿？快给我看看！！怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
This fishing rod... It was submerged in the water for 3 months, but it was found in its original form, or worse, in a state of disrepair.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
这根鱼竿......在水里泡了三个月，找到时却完好如初，甚至像是被修复过。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Ugh...

[Raket]
Um...
- Raket looked intently at his fishing pole, then answered Gein. -
scripts.translation: 拉凯特仔细端详自己的鱼竿，随后回答盖因。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I'm not sure either?
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
我也不清楚？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Certainly!! I don't know, but would you?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
没错！！我也不知道，你又怎么会知道呢？

scripts.text:
[Raket]
Ummm... but I know someone who might know a little about this rod.
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
嗯......不过我认识一个人，或许对这根鱼竿有所了解。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Who??
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
是谁？

scripts.text: Who?
scripts.translation: 谁？

scripts.text: [Raket] His name is Jerrymon, a marine scientist. I've met my father a few times. I know you are in the East Library of Prontera.
scripts.translation: [拉凯特] 他叫杰里蒙，是位海洋学家。我以前见过他几次，知道他在普隆德拉东图书馆。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ah, ah... then... hey adventurer!! I'm sorry for the first meeting, but can I ask you a favor?? We can't get out of here in Izlude...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
啊......这样啊。冒险者！抱歉刚见面就拜托你，能帮我们个忙吗？我们没法离开依斯鲁得......

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Please go see Jerrymon and show him this fishing rod...even if it's trivial...I hope he has some information..
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
请去找杰里蒙，把这根鱼竿给他看看。哪怕能得到一点线索也好......

scripts.text: Okay. Let's go.
scripts.translation: 好，我们走吧。

scripts.text: Sorry. I'm a bit busy right now...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我现在有点忙......

scripts.text:
[Gein]
No... are you sure?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
不......你确定吗？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Are you turning around after hearing about this heartbreaking story and mysterious clue...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
听完这么令人心碎的故事，还发现了神秘线索......你就这样转身要走吗？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ugh... Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
唉......谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
^4d4dffJerrymon^000000 should still be at the <NAVI>[East Library]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI> in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
^4d4dff杰里蒙^000000应该还在普隆德拉的<NAVI>[东图书馆]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Now, I'll give you the fishing rod, a keepsake from Sirood. Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
我把西鲁德留下的鱼竿交给你。请妥善保管......谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
What??? It's a keepsake!! You don't even know if Sirood is alive or dead!!
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
什么？！这是遗物啊！你都不知道西鲁德是死是活呢！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Uhhh... yes I made a mistake, this is the fishing rod Sirood left behind. Please take good care of it.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
呃......你说得对，是我失言了。这是西鲁德留下的鱼竿，麻烦你好好保管。

scripts.text:
[Raket]
I'll tell Jerrymon about the contents in advance through my father!
scripts.translation:
[拉凯特]
我会先让我父亲把情况转告杰里蒙！

scripts.text:
[Gein & Raket & Soup]
Thank you!!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因、拉凯特和汤]
谢谢你！！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
You can go to Prontera's <NAVI>[East Library]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI> as Raket told you.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
照拉凯特说的，去普隆德拉的<NAVI>[东图书馆]<INFO>prontera,192,264,</INFO></NAVI>吧。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Take care of yourself!! I hope there is even the smallest clue...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
保重！！希望能找到哪怕一点线索......

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ah, you're here!!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
啊，你来了！！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Do you have any information about Sirood?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
有西鲁德的消息吗？

scripts.text: - I relayed what I heard from Jerrymon. -
scripts.translation: - 我把从杰里蒙那里听到的消息转述了一遍。 -

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Ah... I see, I've never heard of a trench before.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
啊......原来如此，我从没听说过海沟。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I can't believe there's such a big and deep trench near Izlude...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
真不敢相信依斯鲁得附近竟然有这么宽、这么深的海沟......

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Oh, by the way, is there anything else you need for coming back here?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
对了，你回来时还发现其他东西了吗？

scripts.text: I was wondering if there was anything else found besides the fishing rod.
scripts.translation: 除了鱼竿，还发现了别的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Oh right!!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
啊，对了！！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
It's a chunk scooped up with a landing net near where the fishing rod was found.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
这是在发现鱼竿附近用抄网捞上来的东西。

scripts.text:
- This lump is what Jerrymon said.
^4d4dffIt must be the essence of the abyss^000000. -
scripts.translation: - 这块东西就是杰里蒙说的那种^4d4dff深渊精华^000000。 -

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Something shiny and has the same feeling of Sirood's fishing rod, so I secured it for now.
Could this nugget help?
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
它会发光，摸起来也和西鲁德的鱼竿很像，所以我先收起来了。这个能派上用场吗？

scripts.text: Thanks, that would be a great help.
scripts.translation: 谢谢，这可帮大忙了。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Are you going back to Jerrymon? Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
你要回去找杰里蒙吗？路上小心。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
I hope Sirood will appear in front of us intact, just as the fishing rod appeared intact...
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
希望西鲁德也能像他的鱼竿一样，完好无损地出现在我们面前......

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Please let me know if you have any new information!
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
有新消息的话，请一定告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Gein]
Heh...heh...Hello adventurer, heh...heh... I'm so tired I can't move...

[Gein]
Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
谢谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Gein]
To be able to meet Sirood again is like a dream.
scripts.translation:
[盖因]
能再次见到西鲁德，就像做梦一样。

scripts.text:
You have too many items.
Please clean up your items and try again.
scripts.translation:
你的物品栏已满。
整理好物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Wow... this purple sea... it's fantastic!!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
哇......这片紫色的海洋，简直太奇妙了！！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It's so amazing that we can breathe without gills, there's no sea pressure, and even marine life that I've never seen before...!!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
不用鱼鳃也能呼吸，没有海水压力，甚至还有从没见过的海洋生物......！！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
There's more than one or two things to look into, I'll be busy.
Wow... so exciting!!! I think this is the most thrilling moment in my 14 years as an oceanographer!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
值得调查的东西多得数不清，我可有得忙了。
哇......太让人激动了！！！这是我从事海洋研究14年来最兴奋的时刻！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Lululala~~~
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
啦啦啦～～

scripts.text: Oh hey, I'm here to find Sirood...
scripts.translation: 哦，对了，我是来找西鲁德的......

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Ah, ah... that, right? That should take precedence.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
啊......对，对，救人要紧。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
In order to bring Sirood back ashore, we need an additional ^4d4dff{0}^000000. The question is how to get it...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
要把西鲁德带回岸上，还需要更多^4d4dff{0}^000000。现在的问题是该怎么弄到......

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I've been watching the deep sea creatures here, and I've seen some of them glow with the essence of the abyss.
And they seem to threaten us sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我一直在观察这里的深海生物，发现有些身上散发着深渊精华的光芒。
而且它们有时会威胁我们。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
In that sense, could you handle some of the deep sea creatures? Maybe we can get ^4d4dff{0}^000000 from them.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
能帮忙处理一些深海生物吗？也许能从它们身上找到^4d4dff{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please take out 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.
Okay
scripts.translation: 好。

scripts.text: I'll do it next time
scripts.translation: 下次再说。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes yes~ I'll be waiting for you here!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
好，好～我就在这里等你！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Yes yes~ I'll be waiting for you here!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
好，好～我就在这里等你！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please take out 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thank you for your hard work, you also brought ^4d4dff{0}^000000!! As expected, my prediction was correct.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
辛苦了！你还带来了^4d4dff{0}^000000！看来我的推测没错。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
It looks like we only need about 10 ^4d4dff{0}^000000 to send Sirood back ashore.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
看来只要再收集约10个^4d4dff{0}^000000，就能把西鲁德带回岸上。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
If you collect them, I'll create a whirlpool for you.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
收集好之后，我就为你制造漩涡。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Oh, and this is a stone I found while researching. I've been keeping it because it looks like something that could be used by adventurers, so please take it.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
哦，这是我研究时找到的一块石头。我一直留着，觉得冒险者也许用得上，送给你吧。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then be careful!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那就小心行事！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please bring ^4d4dff10 {0}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
I'd like to save it myself, but as you can see I'm weak, heck.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我也想亲自救他，可你看，我实在太弱了......

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thank you for your hard work!! You brought 10 ^4d4dff{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
辛苦了！！你带来了10个^4d4dff{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Would you like to go ashore now?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
现在要上岸吗？

scripts.text: Go ashore
scripts.translation: 上岸

scripts.text: Not going up now
scripts.translation: 暂时不上岸

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Talk to me when you're ready to go ashore!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
准备上岸时再来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I found this again while waiting for adventurer. Please accept it!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
等冒险者的时候，我又找到了这个。请收下！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Okay, let's condense this...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
好，我来把它凝聚起来......

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Huh...!!

[Jerrymon]
Now, Adventurer and Sirood!! Can you help me?? Ehhh!!!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
冒险者、西鲁德！能来帮我一下吗？哎呀！！

scripts.text: - A huge whirlpool was created in front of Jerrymon! -
scripts.translation: - 一个巨大的漩涡在杰里蒙面前形成了！ -

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then I'll cross first!!! Follow me carefully!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我先过去！！！跟紧了，小心点！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I have everything I need for today's survey, thank you!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
今天调查要用的东西都准备好了，谢谢你！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Looks like you've finished your business. Would you like to move to Izlude?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
看来你已经办完事了。要去依斯鲁得岛吗？

scripts.text: Move
scripts.translation: 前往

scripts.text: Do not move
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please let me know if you need any help!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
需要帮忙的话，尽管告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Okay, huh!

[Jerrymon]
I'm going to cross~~ Ah!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我要过去了～～啊！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Hello, research is going well.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
你好，研究进展很顺利。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
If we do well, we might be able to make the vortex linking here and Izlude last forever!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
如果一切顺利，我们或许能让连接这里和依斯鲁得岛的漩涡永久存在！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
So, can you help me a bit more?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那么，你能再帮我一些忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I need more ^4d4dff{0}^000000, and I'd like you to take care of the ^4d4dffDeep Sea Creatures^000000 that get in the way of my research.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我还需要更多^4d4dff{0}^000000，也请帮我处理妨碍研究的^4d4dff深海生物^000000。

scripts.text: Okay
scripts.translation: 好。

scripts.text: I'll do it next time
scripts.translation: 下次再说。

scripts.text: I want to go back to Izlude
scripts.translation: 我想回依斯鲁得岛。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thanks!! Can you do something for me?
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
谢谢！！还想再拜托你一件事，可以吗？

scripts.text: Next time.
scripts.translation: 下次吧。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
^4d4dff{0}^000000 can be obtained from all the deep sea creatures here.
I need 10 right now.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
所有深海生物都有可能掉落^4d4dff{0}^000000，眼下我需要10个。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Then take care of yourself~~!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那就保重哦～～！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I need 10 ^4d4dff{0}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
Come back to me when you've collected all the essences!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
把精华都收集齐了再回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
You've collected all the {0}!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
你收集齐了所有{0}！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Thank you, I'll put it to good use in my research.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
谢谢你，这些材料对我的研究很有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please kill 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000 and ^4d4dff{2}^000000 that roam around here.

[Jerrymon]
Then take care of yourself~~!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
那就保重哦～～！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Please kill 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.

[Jerrymon]
You've finished dealing with all the deep sea creatures, thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
妨碍研究的深海生物都处理好了，辛苦你了。

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'll get back to you if I need help. Thanks!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
有需要时我再来找你帮忙。谢谢！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
The only person I can ask for is you...
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我现在能求助的只有你了......

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Feel free to tell me if you change your mind!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
改变主意的话，随时告诉我！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
I'll be staying here for a while, so let me know if you change your mind!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我还会在这里待一阵子，改变主意的话记得告诉我！！

scripts.text:
[Jerrymon]
Okay, huh!

[Jerrymon]
I'm going to cross~~ Ah!!
scripts.translation:
[杰里蒙]
我要过去了～～啊！！

scripts.text:
[???]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[不明人士]
你好。

scripts.text: Are you Sirood?
scripts.translation: 你是西鲁德吗？

scripts.text:
[Jane]
No, my name is Jane.
scripts.translation:
[简]
不是，我叫简。

scripts.text:
[Jane]
Sirood...?
I think I've heard that name somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[简]
西鲁德......？
我好像在哪儿听过这个名字......

scripts.text:
[Jane]
Hello, it looks like you've been here a while...
scripts.translation:
[简]
你好，看起来你已经在这里待了一阵子了......

scripts.text:
[Jane]
How do you like it? Isn't this a pretty charming place too?
scripts.translation:
[简]
感觉如何？这里也很迷人吧？

scripts.text:
[Jane]
I should go back to my hometown...
scripts.translation:
[简]
我该回家乡去了......

scripts.text:
[???]
You said you were looking for someone named Sirood?
scripts.translation:
[不明人士]
你说过在找一个叫西鲁德的人？

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
My name is Sunrin.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
我叫孙琳。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Sirood... ah, I think I know who it is.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
西鲁德......啊，我想起来了。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Go all the way to the left, and you'll find him.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
一直往左走，就能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Then have a nice day today!!
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
祝你今天愉快！！

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
All the people here are immigrants and settlers.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
这里的人全都是移民或后来定居的。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
As you can see, there are traces of civilization in these depths, but everyone here was an outsider.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
如你所见，这片深处也留有文明的痕迹，但这里的人全都是外来者。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
You'll get used to it soon.
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
你很快就会习惯这里的。

scripts.text:
[Sunrin]
Sea monsters do attack from time to time, but that's about it...
scripts.translation:
[孙琳]
海怪偶尔会来袭，除此之外倒还好......

scripts.text:
[Nick]
How is it? Is it worth living here?
scripts.translation:
[尼克]
怎么样？你觉得这里住得还习惯吗？

scripts.text:
[Nick]
It's deeper here than anywhere else, and it's amazing to be able to breathe freely.
I'm not sure how that works.
scripts.translation:
[尼克]
这里比任何地方都深，居然还能自由呼吸，真不可思议。
我也不懂其中的原理。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Your strength isn't enough to cross to the lower levels.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
你的实力不足以通过这里前往下层。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Please come back after you are at least level 180.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
至少达到180级后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
If you go downstairs, you will run into some pretty vicious fish. Would that be alright?
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
下楼后会遇到一些非常凶猛的鱼类，你确定要去吗？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: I'll come next time
scripts.translation: 下次再去。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Please talk to me again when you are ready to cross.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
准备好前往下层时，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Then be careful.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
那就小心点。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Hello, would you like to go upstairs again?
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
你好，要再上楼吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Please talk to me again when you are ready to cross.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
准备好前往下层时，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Then be careful.
scripts.translation:
[守门人]
那就小心点。

scripts.text:
You have too many items.
Please clean up your items and try again.
scripts.translation:
你的物品栏已满。
整理好物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Thank you for your hard work. Take a good rest today and visit us tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
辛苦了，今天好好休息，明天再来找我们吧。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Hello, Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
你好，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
I heard that there are many dangerous deep-sea creatures in the lower layer, but when I came here, they were more dangerous than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
我听说下层有许多危险的深海生物，亲眼见到后才发现比想象中还凶猛。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Not too long ago, there was a lot of uproar when a creature from the lower layer came up to the upper layer.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
前阵子有只下层的生物跑到上层来，引起了不小的骚动。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
The population of deep sea creatures is increasing. Adventurer, may I ask for your help?
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
深海生物的数量还在增加。冒险者，能请你帮个忙吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不了。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Oops...

[Kena]
It would be dangerous if left unattended...
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
要是不处理，恐怕会出大事......

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Thank you, I'd appreciate it if you could help me defeat the deep sea creatures or fishmen.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
谢谢。能帮我击退深海生物或鱼人就太好了。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
What would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
你想做什么？

scripts.text: Next time.
scripts.translation: 下次吧。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
I think this is enough for today, please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
今天先到这里吧，明天再来。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please kill 10 each of ^4d4dff{0}^000000, ^4d4dff{1}^000000, and ^4d4dff{2}^000000.

[Kena]
These monsters are quite ferocious, so be very careful.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
这些魔物相当凶猛，一定要小心。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please kill 10 of each.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
请每种都击杀10只。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
They've all been eliminated, thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
它们都已经被清除了，辛苦你了。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
If you have time, please come back tomorrow. I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
有空的话，明天再来吧。我会等你。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
I think this is enough for today, please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
今天先到这里吧，明天再来。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please take out 15 ^4d4dff{0}^000000 and ^4d4dff{1}^000000 each.

[Kena]
They are quite annoying, so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
它们很难缠，小心应付。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please take out 15 ^4d4dff{0}^000000 and ^4d4dff{1}^000000 each.

[Kena]
They've all been eliminated, thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
它们都已经被清除了，辛苦你了。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Please drop by tomorrow when the time is right. I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
明天再来吧，我会等你。

scripts.text:
[Kena]
Oops...

[Kena]
It would be dangerous if left unattended...
scripts.translation:
[凯娜]
放着不管会很危险......

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品栏已满，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
We can't be like this...
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
不能再这样下去了......

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
But until an adventurer strong enough to get there...
scripts.translation:
[米尔科]
可是，在有足够强大的冒险者能抵达那里之前......

scripts.text: == This is a level 160 or higher quest ==
scripts.translation: == 此任务需要达到160级以上 ==

scripts.text:
[Yolanda]
Are you really in?
scripts.translation:
[约兰达]
你真的要参加吗？

scripts.text:
[Mirko]
That's right. A lot of people said they saw it.

我......咳......必须亲自去......咳咳......
也许帮不上什么忙，可是......咳。
我最要好的朋友......咳......可能有危险，我不能坐视不管！咳......

scripts.text:
[Acid]
Cough cough..Adventurer..Cough..Take me with you!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
咳咳......冒险者......咳......带我一起去！
求你了！

scripts.text:
[Acid]
I've been in the mines for most of these days, so my cough seems to be getting better.
My body has become healthy!
The air here is worse than the mine... Cough
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
这几天我大多待在矿里，咳嗽好像好多了。
身体也恢复健康了！
这里的空气比矿坑还糟......咳。

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
Stand in line!
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
排好队！

scripts.text: Why are you standing here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么站在这里？

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
What?
Do you think I'd give such advanced information to a stranger I am seeing for the first time?
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
什么？你觉得我会把这么机密的情报告诉第一次见面的陌生人吗？

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
If you're that curious, stand behind me and wait for your turn!
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
这么好奇的话，就站到我后面排队，等轮到你！

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
Information isn't something you get for free.
All the time and effort...
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
情报可不是白拿的。
得花时间和心力......

scripts.text:
[???????????]
AAAAAAAAAA!!!!
Let go!!!!
You furry bastards!!!!
scripts.translation:
[不明人士]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！
放开我！！！！
你们这群毛茸茸的混蛋！！！！

scripts.text: - A man's scream is heard from the front of the line. Let's check the situation at the front. -
scripts.translation: - 队伍前方传来男人的尖叫声。去看看出了什么事。 -

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
Have you heard something strange?
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
你听到什么怪声了吗？

scripts.text: - A man's scream is heard from the front of the line. Let's check the situation at the front. -

scripts.translation:

排好队！

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
Hey there!!! Don't cut in line!!!
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
喂！！！别插队！！！

scripts.text:
[Resident]
One day, everyone started queuing up here, so I stood here too.
What's in front?
Well? I'm just here because I'm curious...
scripts.translation:
[居民]
有一天，大家突然开始在这里排队，我也就跟着排了。
前面有什么？谁知道呢，我只是好奇......

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
Everyone stands in line for days waiting for their turn.
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
大家都在这里排了好几天，等着轮到自己。

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
Whoops, it's my turn to go in soon.
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
哎呀，快轮到我进去了。

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
Whh..what happened?
I heard a scream when the man in front of me just entered.
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
怎、怎么回事？我前面那个人刚进去就传来一声尖叫。

scripts.text: About the man.
scripts.translation: 关于那个男人。

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
What?
I didn't even have time to look at that!
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
什么？我连看清都来不及！

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
Flaw... Hehe... .
I've been waiting in line for days, but suddenly I'm not interested anymore...
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
呼......呵呵......我排了好几天，突然就没兴趣了......

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
If you're really curious, I'll give you my position. Why don't you go in and check it out?
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
你要是真好奇，我把位置让给你。进去看看不就知道了？

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
I...it's not because I'm scared!
I just... I guess what is inside is boring for me now.
Because I've lost interest?!
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
我......我才不是害怕！
只是......我现在觉得里面没意思了。
大概是因为失去兴趣了吧？！

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
Flaw... Hehe... .
I've been waiting in line for days, but suddenly I'm not interested anymore...
scripts.translation:

只是......我现在觉得里面没意思了。
大概是因为失去兴趣了吧？！

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear in line]
What?
The guy in front has already ran away!
Don't get confused!
scripts.translation:
[排队的泰迪熊]
什么？前面那个人已经跑掉了！别弄错了！

scripts.text: - Can't get in yet -
scripts.translation: - 现在还不能进去。 -

scripts.text:

- You have too many items. -

- Lighten your weight and -

scripts.translation:

- 你的物品栏已满。 -
- 无法接收此物品。 -
- 请减轻负重后 -
- 再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Can't you let me go?!
Let me go!
This sucks!!!!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
你就不能放我走吗？！
放开我！
真是糟透了！！！！

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear]
Oops!
Caught, I got caught!
Let's run!!!!
scripts.translation:
[泰迪熊]
哎呀！
被抓到了，我被抓到了！
快逃啊！！！！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
What...
That's...

[Steven]
Hey!
You there!
Did you see that too?
The Teddy Bear just...
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
喂！你！
你也看到了吧？
刚才那只泰迪熊......

scripts.text: Tell him about the coughing young man.
scripts.translation: 把咳嗽的年轻人的事告诉他。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Huh? The coughing young man in Einbroch asked you to find me?
Is it Acid...
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
什么？艾音布罗克那个咳嗽的年轻人让你来找我？
是阿西德吗......

scripts.text:
[Steven]
I told him I'd come back right away, but what the hell was the rumor about? There were a lot of people and monsters waiting in line.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
我明明跟他说马上就回去，可这到底是什么传闻？好多人和魔物都在排队。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
So how was Acid?
He couldn't sleep well because his cough got so bad.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
阿西德怎么样了？
他的咳嗽越来越严重，连觉都睡不好。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
I have to go back and send him to the hospital, but...
If I'm not mistaken, that's...
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
我得回去送他去医院，可是......
如果我没记错的话，那是......

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Ugh...things got messy...
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
唉......事情变得一团糟......

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Hey.
Do me a favor.
He has to go to the hospital today and won't have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
喂，帮我个忙。
他今天得去医院，可钱不够。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
I think I need to do some work here.
You go back and tell him that I'm all right.
Give him this money too.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
我想我得先在这里找份工作。你回去告诉他我没事，
再把这笔钱交给他。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Please.
When I go back... I don't have anything, but I'll give you something in return.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
拜托了。
等我回去后......虽然现在没什么东西，还是会给你谢礼。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Hey.
Do me a favor.
He has to go to the hospital today and won't have enough money.
scripts.translation:

喂，帮我个忙。

[Steven]
Please.

scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
拜托了。
等我回去后......虽然现在没什么东西，还是会给你谢礼。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Oh you are here?
Did he go to the hospital?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
哦，你来了？他去医院了吗？

scripts.text:
[Acid]
Steven!
Why make people so worried...
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
史蒂文！
你怎么能让大家这么担心......

scripts.text:
[Steven]
No... why are you here?
Go to the hospital!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
不......你怎么跑到这里来了？快去医院！

scripts.text:
[Acid]
Do I have a hospital or a shop now?!
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
现在是有医院还是商店啊？！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Ugh...
Okay...okay!
Be quiet for now!
Can you hear something strange coming from the north?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
唉......
好吧，好吧！先安静一下！
你们听到北边传来什么怪声了吗？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Ugh...
Okay!
Be quiet for now!
Can you hear something strange coming from the north?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
唉......
好吧！先安静一下！
你们听到北边传来什么怪声了吗？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Too many of them.
This is too dangerous.
Let's clear things up and talk again.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
数量太多了，这里太危险。
先把它们解决掉，再继续谈。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Whoa...
Did you send them out?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
哇......
是你把它们赶出去的吗？

scripts.text:
[Acid]
Aren't those just Teddy Bears?
Invading... they called themselves Nazarians, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
那不就是泰迪熊吗？
入侵者......它们自称纳扎里安，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
What the hell is going on...
I'm out of my mind...
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
这到底是怎么回事......
我脑子都乱了......

scripts.text: About Teddy Bear
scripts.translation: 关于泰迪熊

scripts.text:
[Acid]
Steven brought it because he said he was looking for something salty to eat at home.
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
史蒂文说想在家里找些咸味零食，就把它带回来了。

scripts.text:
[Acid]
The pay is so good compared to the job, and the delivery place is also a mine, so it was a bit suspicious...
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
这工作报酬高得离谱，送货地点又是矿场，我当时就觉得有点可疑......

scripts.text:
[Acid]
I've been told that idiot is excited.
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
听说那个笨蛋还挺兴奋的。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
What an idiot!
Thanks to you, I get hospital bills and your cough...
Oh... Come to think of it, you don't cough anymore, do you?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
真是个笨蛋！害我得付医院账单，还得操心你的咳嗽......
哦，说起来，你现在不咳了吧？

scripts.text:
[Acid]
Uh... is that so?
Come to think of it, I feel like I can breathe easier!
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
呃......是吗？
这么一说，呼吸确实顺畅多了！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
No matter how many times I went to the hospital, there was no improvement...
Maybe it was just the bad air!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
我跑了好几次医院，病情却一点没好转......
也许只是空气太差了！

scripts.text:
[Acid]
No, that's not important right now...
The doll we made is alive and moving!
They even tried to kidnap you!
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
不，这不是重点......
我们做的玩偶居然活了，还会自己行动！
它们甚至想绑架你！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Kidnapped... Come to think of it, I helped a man who was being chased by a terrific Teddy Bear on the way back.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
绑架......说起来，我回来的路上还帮了一个被巨型泰迪熊追赶的男人。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
...I'm not the only one brought here, am I?
I guess I'll have to stay here and watch the situation.
Acid! You can go back to the village for now.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
......看来不只我一个人被带到这里。
我得留下来观察情况。阿西德，你先回村子去。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Thank you for helping me too.
I can't give you much, but I'll give you the rare ore I found earlier.
It might come in handy somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
也谢谢你帮忙。我没什么好送的，就把之前找到的稀有矿石给你吧，也许以后用得上！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Get some rest
If you overdo it, you'll only ruin your health.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
先休息一下。
太勉强的话，身体会吃不消。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Ugh...
Where do these guys keep popping up?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
唉......
这些家伙怎么老是冒出来？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
If you're familiar with combat, puppeteers who aren't familiar with combat won't find it easy to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
这里到处都是魔物，不擅长战斗的操偶师很难脱身。

scripts.text:
[Steven]
For now, I'm also taking care of it, but I'm not good enough alone.
If you're not busy right now, help me defeat {0}, {1}, and {2}.
I think I'll be able to breathe a little more if I catch 10 of them.
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
我也在处理这些魔物，但光靠我一个人不够。
你现在有空的话，帮我击败{0}、{1}和{2}吧。每种抓10只，我才能稍微喘口气。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Okay...

[Steven]
Then please help me defeat
10 {0}, {1}, and {2}!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
那就拜托你帮我击败{0}、{1}和{2}，每种10只！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
How are you?
How are things going with {0}, {1}, and {2}?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
最近怎么样？
{0}、{1}和{2}处理得如何？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Whoa...
Good job!
Are you feeling a little safer now?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
哇......
干得好！
现在感觉安全些了吗？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Can't you let me go?!
Let me go!
This sucks!!!!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
你就不能放我走吗？！
放开我！
真是糟透了！！！！

scripts.text:
[Teddy Bear]
Oops!
Caught, I got caught!
Let's run!!!!
scripts.translation:
[泰迪熊]
哎呀！
被抓到了，我被抓到了！
快逃啊！！！！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Um hahahahahahahahaha!!!!
Listen, people!
Finally the day has come when we will rise again!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
呜哈哈哈哈哈哈！！！！
听好了，各位！
我们终于等到重新崛起的这一天了！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Forget the shameful past of being trapped in the dark and damp ground.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
忘掉过去吧，忘掉我们曾被困在阴暗潮湿的地底，受尽屈辱的日子。

scripts.text:
[??????]
This land!!!
This world!!!!
Until the day they are at our feet, us Nazarians!!!!
Will not stop the invasion!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
这片土地！！！
这个世界！！！！
纳扎里安人绝不会停止入侵，直到一切都臣服在我们脚下！！！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Okay! A new body has arrived!
We will plant our holy core into the body that is only an empty shell!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安人]
好！新的躯体送来了！
我们要把神圣核心植入这具空壳！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Drivius! Come on get it!!!
scripts.translation:
[??????]
德里维乌斯！快把它拿来！！！

scripts.text:
[Drivius]
Yes!!! His Majesty is here!!!
scripts.translation:
[德里维乌斯]
是！！！陛下驾到！！！

scripts.text:
[Emperor of Nazarians]
Ha ha... look!
This bright and beautiful figure...
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安皇帝]
哈哈......看啊！
这副明亮又美丽的躯体......

scripts.text:
[Emperor of Nazarians]
People!!!
Welcome!
Brave newly born soldiers!!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安皇帝]
各位！！
欢迎！
勇敢的新生战士们！！！！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Waaaaaaaa!!!!
Long live the Emperor!!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安人]
哇啊啊啊啊！！！！
皇帝万岁！！！！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Hooray!!! Hooray!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安人]
万岁！！！万岁！！！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Look at those dashing soldiers over there!!!
Awesome!!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安人]
快看那边英姿飒爽的战士们！！！
太帅了！！！！

scripts.text:
[Emperor of Nazarians]
The world will bow before the mighty power of the Nazarians!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安皇帝]
纳扎里安的强大力量，必将令全世界俯首称臣！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Waaaaaaaa!!!!
Long live the Emperor!!!!
Hooray!!! Hooray!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安人]
哇啊啊啊啊！！！！
皇帝万岁！！！！
万岁！！！万岁！！！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Wait what's that?
Isn't that the doll we made?
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
等等，那是什么？
那不是我们做的玩偶吗？

scripts.text:
[Acid]
I guess so?
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
好像是？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
It does not only look like that, it is the one we made!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
不只是长得像，那根本就是我们做的那个！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
It's the one who made a mess because you sewed wrong?? Yes!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
就是你缝错了，弄得一团糟的那个玩偶？没错！

scripts.text:
[Acid]
What a mess...
That one has its own cuteness point?
scripts.translation:
[阿西德]
真是一团糟......
不过它倒也有自己的可爱之处？

scripts.text:
[Steven]
...cute horns...

[Emperor of Nazarians]
Hmm...
Oops...

[Emperor of Nazarians]

scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安皇帝]
看来有只老鼠混进了神圣集会。

scripts.text:
[Emperor of Nazarians]
Warriors of Nazarians!!!!
Punish the intruder!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安皇帝]
纳扎里安的战士们！！！！
惩罚入侵者！！！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
From our name!
We'll do it!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安人]
为了纳扎里安之名！
我们一定做到！

scripts.text:
[Nazarians]
Waaaaaaa!!!
Punish them!
It's an intruder!!!
scripts.translation:
[纳扎里安人]
哇啊啊啊！！！
惩罚他们！
有入侵者！！！

scripts.text:
[Steven]
Oops!
Looks like we got caught?!
scripts.translation:
[史蒂文]
